info.description:
Complete API collection with automated tests for all business flows.

## Quick Start
1. Set `base_url` → `http://192.168.23.67:30400`
2. Run **[SETUP] Login Admin** → auto-saves `admin_token`
3. Run **[SETUP] Login Parent** → auto-saves `parent_token`, `parent_profile_id`
4. Run **[SETUP] Login Child (Aisha)** → auto-saves `child_token`, `child_profile_id`
5. Run Collection with "Run All" untuk automated test seluruh flow

## Test Credentials
| Role | Login | Password |
|------|-------|----------|
| ADMIN | admin@byond.id | Admin@Byond2026! |
| PARENT | budi.santoso@demo.byond.id | Byond@2026 |
| CHILD 1 (Aisha) | username: aisha_byond | 123456 |
| CHILD 2 (Rizky) | username: rizky_byond | 654321 |
